title: EHR and Health Information System Architecture
summary: What an EHR actually is under the hood: clinical data repository, CPOE, results review, documentation, integration engine, and the rest of the stack. What 'modular' buys you, what it doesn't, and why interoperability is harder than it sounds.
learningOutcomes: Diagram the major components of a modern EHR and explain what each does.
Explain the role of an integration engine and why it exists.
Compare best-of-breed and integrated EHR strategies on cost, risk, and clinician experience.
Define interoperability at the four levels (foundational, structural, semantic, organizational) and give an example of failure at each level.
Read a real EHR architecture diagram and identify weak points.
